title: Playing with the radio-studio musicians in Vienna
summary: Davenport recalls the excellent Vienna musicians who backed him, a symphony drummer and radio-studio players.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Oh, man. I played with the dream band over there when I played in Vienna.
Yeah. Do you know how that works?
Well, if he talks too loud, you just turn it down. If those lines cross, is all.
This down right here. That's the volume control. I'm sorry, Walsh. You're talking about a dream band?
I'm just killing all that. I don't know the fellas' band, but when I played in Vienna, they had a band for these guys. They were very good positions. Vienna put on some of the best positions.
The drummer plays jazz for fun, but he plays piano symphony over there.

The piano player and the tenor-psychlor player play with the radio studio. And they're excellent musicians. And those are the guys that got to back me. And when I played with them, it just felt like I was floating on air. Everything was so strange.
